title: Logs Meanwhile Information
description: A surreal scene depicts a large open book floating in the center with glowing text reading 'LOGS MEANWHILE INFORMATION'. To the left, a tall glass vase overflows with long scrolls of paper. To the right, a wooden cabinet has multiple open drawers spilling out papers and documents. A lit candle sits on the stone floor in the foreground surrounded by scattered wax seals and papers. The background shows draped walls covered in documents under a starry night sky.
